plan: Implement mainWorkflow to call trigger_0 to start the flow.
Build ai_input with system and user messages for bird joke generation.
Call action_0 with ai_input to generate the joke.
Extract the joke text from AI output.
Wrap the joke text into Slack input format with channel #jokes and messageType text.
Call action_1 to send the joke to Slack.
